notes: F1 event times are stored as UTC/timezone-aware sessions and rendered for America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires with Intl.DateTimeFormat. Miami 2026 was corrected so it renders Sprint 13:00 ART, Qualifying 17:00 ART and Race 17:00 ART.
F2 session times were taken from the official F2 round pages and are track times unless otherwise noted.
For F2, both sprint_race and feature_race are included because the championship runs two race sessions per round.
F2 driver profiles include official page URLs, nationality/country codes, dates of birth and official Formula 2 Cloudinary driver/team image assets refreshed from FIA Formula 2 pages on 2026-05-04.
Formula 1 race results include full classified/NC rows for Australia, China and Japan as published before the Miami race weekend on 2026-05-02.
Formula 2 event times are event-local when known; the app converts known times to America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires using Intl. TBC remains visible as TBC.
Miami 2026 Sprint Qualifying, Sprint, Qualifying and Race are loaded from official Formula1.com results; Miami is treated as completed for upcoming-race filtering.
Formula 1 constructor standings are stored manually from official Formula1.com team standings consulted on 2026-05-02 and are not recalculated from session results.
F2 2026 drivers, calendar, Melbourne/Miami results and driver standings were refreshed from official FIA Formula 2 pages on 2026-05-04.

Canada 2026 F1 Sprint Qualifying, Sprint, Qualifying and Race plus F2 Qualifying, Sprint and Feature Race were loaded from official Formula1.com/FIA Formula 2 results on 2026-05-25; practice/free practice results were verified but not stored because the existing result-session schema does not support practice sessions.

F2 team standings were added under formula2_standings.teams from the official FIA Formula 2 team standings; Hitech TGR is normalized to the existing Hitech team name used by local F2 driver/team assets.

Monaco and Barcelona-Catalunya 2026 F1 results/standings plus Monaco and Barcelona 2026 F2 race results/standings were refreshed from official Formula1.com and FIA Formula 2 pages on 2026-06-20. F2 Monaco split qualifying was verified but not duplicated in session_results because the existing result-session schema only has a single formula2 qualifying type.
asset_notes: Driver headshot URLs come from OpenF1's drivers endpoint and point to official media.formula1.com assets.
Most team logo URLs were replaced with direct public asset links from Wikimedia Commons.
Racing Bulls team_logo_url remains null because a stable direct logo asset was not verified in this pass.
F2 driver headshot and team logo URLs come from official FIA Formula 2 Cloudinary assets linked by the Teams & Drivers and driver profile pages.
